verdict.rationale: Kick documents its own export paths: the Tax Package produces a single Excel file, reports sync into Google Sheets as live spreadsheet data, and the CLI pulls transactions and financial statements. None of these is documented as a complete, all-data export in open formats for leaving the product, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export (ledger, journal entries, rules, attachments, audit trail), explicit open formats such as CSV or JSON, offboarding/account-closure guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
